Picker.Title: Select Test Purposes

QuickView.QualifierHint: Qualifiers can be combined with a primary purpose.
QuickView.BaseHint: The base is only a suggestion. GUM does not limit this purpose to a specific attribute or ability.
QuickView.TagHint: Specific tags restrict the modifier to this purpose or a closely related situation. Inherited categories can also reach other related purposes.
QuickView.Title: Purpose: {label}

general.Label: General Test
general.Description: A neutral purpose used when no specific mechanical purpose is selected. It produces no semantic tags and does not activate purpose-filtered modifiers.

knockdown_stun.Label: Knockdown and Stunning from Injury
knockdown_stun.Description: An immediate HT roll caused by a major wound or certain injuries to the head or vitals. Failure causes knockdown and physical stunning. Failure by 5 or more, or a critical failure, can also cause unconsciousness.

Distinctions.0: Recovering later from physical stun.
Distinctions.1: Staying conscious at 0 HP or less.
Distinctions.3: Directly resisting sleep, coma, or unconsciousness.

recover_physical_stun.Label: Recover from Physical Stun
recover_physical_stun.Description: Test related to recover from physical stun.

Distinctions.0: The initial knockdown and stunning roll caused by injury.
Regaining consciousness after already becoming unconscious.
Rolls to stay conscious.

crippling_recovery.Label: Recover from Crippling Injury
crippling_recovery.Description: Test related to recover from crippling injury.

Distinctions.0: Unconsciousness caused by failing injury-related rolls.

resist_alcohol.Label: Resist Alcohol
resist_alcohol.Description: Use when resisting the effects of alcohol and intoxication.

Distinctions.0: General resistance to other metabolic hazards or addiction/withdrawal.

fright_check.Label: Fright Check
fright_check.Description: A roll made when facing a terrifying or psychologically traumatic situation.

Distinctions.0: Any generic roll against fear; Resist Fear may cover situations that do not specifically use a Fright Check.
Fright Check: this purpose may cover fear rolls that do not specifically use those rules.

avoid_mental_stun.Label: Avoid Mental Stun
avoid_mental_stun.Description: Test related to avoid mental stun.

Distinctions.0: Physical stunning caused by injury.

recover_mental_stun.Label: Recover from Mental Stun
recover_mental_stun.Description: Test related to recover from mental stun.

Distinctions.0: Recovery from physical stunning.

resist_mental_influence.Label: Resist Mental Influence
resist_mental_influence.Description: Test related to resist mental influence.

memorize.Label: Memorize
memorize.Description: Use when deliberately committing new information to memory.

Distinctions.0: Recalling already learned information; memorizing is committing new content.

recall_information.Label: Recall Information
recall_information.Description: Use when remembering or retrieving information already learned.

Distinctions.0: Memorizing new content; recall retrieves something already learned.

prolonged_mental_task.Label: Prolonged Mental Task
prolonged_mental_task.Description: Use for an intellectual task that demands sustained effort over a long period.

Distinctions.0: A brief mental roll or simple maintenance of concentration.

creativity.Label: Creativity/Inventiveness
creativity.Description: Use to create, improvise, or find an inventive solution.

Distinctions.0: Recalling knowledge or merely performing a known technique.

avoid_fall.Label: Avoid a Fall
avoid_fall.Description: Test related to avoid a fall.

Distinctions.0: Breaking a fall that has already occurred.

controlled_fall.Label: Controlled Fall/Break a Fall
controlled_fall.Description: Test related to controlled fall/break a fall.

Distinctions.0: Avoiding a fall; this purpose is used after the fall is already happening.
Knockback caused by damage.

resist_knockback_fall.Label: Remain Standing after Knockback
resist_knockback_fall.Description: Test related to remain standing after knockback.

Distinctions.0: The calculation of knockback distance.

sleep_rest.Label: Fall Asleep/Get Rest
sleep_rest.Description: Test related to fall asleep/get rest.

Distinctions.0: Resistance to attacks that use a sense as a vector.
Resistance to attacks that use vision as a vector.
Resistance to attacks that use hearing as a vector.
Resistance to attacks that use taste or smell as a vector.

sense_smell.Label: Smell
sense_smell.Description: Use to perceive, identify, or distinguish odors through smell.

Distinctions.0: A taste-only roll.
Distinctions.1: An attack that uses smell as a vector; testing a sense is not resisting through that channel.

sense_taste.Label: Taste
sense_taste.Description: Use to perceive, identify, or distinguish flavors through taste.

Distinctions.0: A smell-only roll.
Distinctions.1: An attack that uses taste as a vector; testing a sense is not resisting through that channel.

Distinctions.0: Resistance to attacks that use touch as a vector.

resist_magic.Label: Resist Magic
resist_magic.Description: Qualifier for direct resistance to the source; it does not automatically apply to indirect physical consequences.

Distinctions.0: Indirect physical consequences of a spell; this purpose represents direct resistance to magical influence.

resist_psionic.Label: Resist Psionics
resist_psionic.Description: Qualifier for direct resistance to the source; it does not automatically apply to indirect physical consequences.

resist_supernatural_power.Label: Resist Supernatural Power
resist_supernatural_power.Description: Qualifier for direct resistance to the source; it does not automatically apply to indirect physical consequences.

resist_power.Label: Resist Power
resist_power.Description: Qualifier for direct resistance to the source; it does not automatically apply to indirect physical consequences.

resist_telepathy.Label: Resist Telepathy
resist_telepathy.Description: Qualifier for direct resistance to the source; it does not automatically apply to indirect physical consequences.

sensory_vector_vision.Label: Visual-Channel Attack
sensory_vector_vision.Description: Use when the attack or effect reaches the target through the visual channel.

Distinctions.0: Vision roll; the vector describes how an attack arrives, not which sense is being tested.

sensory_vector_hearing.Label: Auditory-Channel Attack
sensory_vector_hearing.Description: Use when the attack or effect reaches the target through the auditory channel.

Distinctions.0: Hearing roll; the vector describes how an attack arrives, not which sense is being tested.

sensory_vector_smell.Label: Olfactory-Channel Attack
sensory_vector_smell.Description: Use when the attack or effect reaches the target specifically through smell.

Distinctions.0: Smell roll and gustatory channel.

sensory_vector_taste.Label: Gustatory-Channel Attack
sensory_vector_taste.Description: Use when the attack or effect reaches the target specifically through taste.

Distinctions.0: Taste roll and olfactory channel.

sensory_vector_touch.Label: Tactile-Channel Attack
sensory_vector_touch.Description: Use when the attack or effect reaches the target through contact or the tactile channel.

Distinctions.0: Touch roll.

sensory_vector_smell_taste.Label: Olfactory or Gustatory-Channel Attack
sensory_vector_smell_taste.Description: Use for a shared vector that can act through smell or taste.

Distinctions.0: Smell or Taste roll; this is an attack-vector category.

inhaled_agent.Label: Inhaled Agent
inhaled_agent.Description: Use when gas, smoke, or another agent must be breathed or inhaled.

Distinctions.0: Suffocation without an inhaled agent and attacks that act only through a sense.

be_heard.Label: Make Yourself Heard
be_heard.Description: Use to project the voice and be heard despite distance or noise.

Distinctions.0: The listener's Hearing roll and a social roll focused on content rather than voice range.

appear_honest.Label: Appear Honest/Trustworthy
appear_honest.Description: Use when appearing sincere, honest, or trustworthy is relevant to the social roll.

Distinctions.0: Being objectively truthful; this qualifier describes the impression conveyed.

fashion_context.Label: Fashion and Style
fashion_context.Description: Use when knowledge, presentation, or suitability involving fashion and style is relevant.

Distinctions.0: General social reaction unrelated to fashion or style.

healthy_appearance.Label: Healthy Appearance
healthy_appearance.Description: Use when an appearance of health and vitality influences the social roll.

Distinctions.0: Disease resistance; only the social appearance of health matters here.

unnecessary_risk.Label: Unnecessary Risk
unnecessary_risk.Description: Use when the character voluntarily takes a significant, unnecessary risk.

Distinctions.0: Unavoidable danger or risk necessary to achieve the objective.
